exposure: Gestational age at delivery: <37 weeks, 37-41 weeks, >41 weeks
cohort: 190 women with an unfavorable cervix (Bishop score < 2) undergoing induction of labor
finding: A misoprostol vaginal insert for induction of labor was effective in achieving vaginal delivery within 48 hours, with a higher rate of vaginal deliveries, shorter time to delivery, and lower need for oxytocin augmentation observed in the post-term group (>41 weeks).
mod_finding: A misoprostol vaginal insert for induction of labor was effective in achieving vaginal delivery within 48 hours, with a higher rate of vaginal deliveries observed in the post-term group (>41 weeks).
